editorial.description_en: A rice field in midsummer, fully green and not yet turning. The strongest yellow-green in the corpus.
editorial.description_ja: 夏の青田のような、こい緑。

provenance.derivation: Editorial construction, not a measurement. Specified in OKLCh as L 0.686, C 0.104, h 130.0° and converted to canonical D65 XYZ by @irodora/color-spaces 0.1.0 (oklchToXyz), rounded to six decimal places. Re-derivable from this sentence alone.
provenance.editorialNotes: Name coined by Irodora: 青 (ao, green in the older sense) + 田 (ta, rice field). It is not asserted to be a traditional Japanese colour name, and the hyphenated romaji marks it as a constructed compound (ADR-0065). "Green Paddy" is an editorial decision about what communicates in English, not a literal translation of 青田. Relations asserted from measured proximity under the current engine, not from a source: related is the three nearest in CIELAB — kawa-goke at ΔE00 11.3, hina-gusa at ΔE00 11.8, haru-na at ΔE00 12.7. complementary is empty because no entry in this corpus sits within 22° of the opposite hue. historicalVariants is empty: this entry makes no historical claim to vary from.
